pageCache.pageTitle: Heathlands Primary Academy - Coastal Learning Partnership
pageCache.text:
Coastal Learning Partnership
Thank you for taking an interest in Heathlands Primary Academy, which is a highly valued member of the Multi Academy Trust, Coastal Learning Partnership (CLP).
CLP is a single family of twenty schools across two Local Authority areas: Dorset Council and Bournemouth, Christchurch & Poole Council. The two furthermost points of CLP are Boscombe and Swanage. There are about 5,400 pupils overall who are supported by around 900 committed staff.
Our schools work closely together in a spirit of professional generosity and collaboration, sharing resource and expertise.
Although part of the same single family, every school in CLP is different and unique and those differences are greatly valued. Each school has its own identify and values which express the local communities that they serve. Those schools within CLP which are church schools express their Christian distinctiveness through their unique vision.
CLP’s motto is ‘Broadening Horizons Together’. This is because we want every member of the CLP community to really flourish; children enjoy an inspiring educational experience and staff enjoy professional opportunity and fulfilment. That is achieved through being part of a single learning community.
CLP has three core values which influence the way in which we work together:
Serve: Schools in CLP serve each another as well as their local communities and families
Inspire: Staff inspire each other and their pupils
Empower: Schools, and everyone in them, are empowered to be their very best
Heathlands Primary Academy has made a commitment to the CLP family, secure in the knowledge that serving others in this way will lead to a better educational experience for all of the pupils.
If you would like to learn more about the work of the Partnership and its other schools, or to view documentation such as statutory accounts, please visit the Coastal Learning Partnership website.
You can contact Coastal Learning Partnership directly as follows:
Email: office@coastalpartnership.co.uk
Coastal Learning Partnership
Heathlands Primary Academy

pageCache.pageTitle: Heathlands Primary Academy - Reception New Starters September 2026
pageCache.text:
Reception New Starters September 2026
My name is Emma Burton and I am the Early years lead here at Heathlands.
We have our Caterpillars class for our nursery children who can join us the term after they have turned three and our Butterflies reception class. We are very lucky to have lots of outdoor learning space as well as our woodland area known as the Spinney. The children who start in our Early Years leave us with an excellent attitude to learning and play, they become independent and simply love being part of the Heathlands family. They build strong relationships with the foundation team staff and this supports their confidence as they continue their journey through the school. We set high expectations for behaviour and support the children to meet these which means that they are in the best position to learn. Our classrooms are buzzing with excitement and determination which makes it a very magical place to be.
If you have chosen to join us at Heathlands then we are very excited to meet you, if you are still considering your options - why not make an appointment to have a tour and meet with staff.
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us for more information.
We will be writing to all new parents in the first two weeks after Easter break to welcome you and your child and make arrangements for you to come and visit and meet the team.
We look forward to welcoming you to our school community.

pageCache.pageTitle: Heathlands Primary Academy - Breakfast/After-School Clubs (Wraparound Care)
pageCache.text:
Breakfast/After-School Clubs (Wraparound Care)
Breakfast Club at Heathlands is open from 7.40am - 8.40am every morning and is in the school hall.
This is a safe space for children to have breakfast and play with friends before school starts under school staff supervision.
This provision is not open to Nursery children.
Children who attend Breakfast Club are offered:
a selection of cereals and toast.
Jam, honey and Marmite are available each day as toppings for toast.
On occasion we may have other items on offer for children to choose from.
The last serving of breakfast is at 8.20 am so children must arrive before then if they are to eat.
Children will be looked after until the start of the school day and will go direct to their class from the hall once school starts. Reception children will be escorted to the classroom.
The cost is £2.50 per child per session including breakfast.
Sessions need to be booked no later than 24hrs in advance of a session and payment is required at the time of booking. Booking will not be taken on the day.
Breakfast Club payments
Payments must be made via the Parent Portal through Arbor. You will be provided with a login on your child's first day at Heathlands.
